jobs.description:
At Amazon, we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can discover virtually anything they want online. Our evolution from website to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of our DNA.

Join our APAC AMET compensation team where you'll shape compensation strategies for one of the world's most innovative companies. You'll have the opportunity to:

• Drive impactful compensation programs across multiple markets

• Partner with senior leaders to develop creative solutions for complex compensation challenges

• Lead strategic initiatives that directly influence our ability to attract and retain top talent

• Work in a fast-paced, data-driven environment that values innovation and ownership


Key job responsibilities
You'll have opportunities to:

• Partner with global teams on innovative compensation solutions

• Drive strategic initiatives that impact thousands of employees

• Develop deep expertise in international markets and compensation practices

• Build influential relationships across all levels of the organization

• This role will be based out of Bengaluru, India

jobs.description:
The HR Senior Administrator is responsible for accurately processing bonuses, allowances, and generating compensation-related letters in a timely manner. This role requires attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to collaborate with various stakeholders, including HR, business units, Payroll, Finance, and employees. The ideal candidate should be a quick learner, team player, and drive for process automation to effectively support the work.

The successful candidate will be responsible for keying and processing compensation transactions, generating compensation change letters, and bonus award letters, while ensuring compliance with company policies and regulations. They will engage with HR stakeholders, business units, and support functions to resolve compensation-related inquiries and issues, fostering strong relationships and trust. They will review processes and document business requirement supporting automation initiatives

Additionally, the HR Senior Administrator will play a crucial role in continuously improving processes, identifying areas for optimization, and driving innovative solutions to enhance efficiency and accuracy. Maintaining accurate records, adhering to data privacy and security standards, and staying informed about relevant laws and regulations related to compensation and benefits are essential aspects of this role.

Embodying Amazon's Leadership Principles of Customer Obsession, Invent and Simplify, Deliver Results, and Earn Trust, the HR Senior Administrator will contribute to the team's vision of building optimizable compensation service delivery teams, creating synergies and efficiencies, and striving for zero-defects within our processes.

Key job responsibilities
Input, update and maintain employee related data in a timely manner with a strong eye-for-detail while making data entries and while preparing documents

Maintain, manage and regularly audit the work

Partner with diverse HR teams, provide support and process transactions to deliver a top-notch day one experience to Employees.

Carry out audits and checks on data changes to ensure accuracy and adhere to strict confidentiality standards.

Identify bottlenecks and trouble shoot issues.

Ensure service level commitments and quality standards are met.

Drive changes to improve efficiency and effectiveness of the processes.

Lead projects as subject matter expert and work towards the goals of the project.

Lead process automation initiatives collaborating with tech team to improve customer experience
